segments.speaker: Maya
segments.text: Yeah, so I just got off with Northstar Facilities. They’re good with 78 seats for year one, starting October 1, but they want the invoice dated after their September 18 board meeting.

segments.speaker: Jordan
segments.text: Okay. Same $42 per seat per month from the pricing sheet, or did you give them any services discount?

segments.speaker: Maya
segments.text: Same seat price. I held services at $6,800 for onboarding, three remote sessions plus the admin setup. They asked if we could make payment net 45 instead of net 30.

segments.speaker: Jordan
segments.text: Net 45 is probably fine if legal doesn’t kick it back. Any redlines on auto-renewal?

segments.speaker: Maya
segments.text: No, just a 30-day notice window instead of 60. Their ops director said that’s what procurement expects across all their software agreements.

segments.speaker: Jordan
segments.text: Got it. Are you trying to get this out today?

segments.speaker: Maya
segments.text: I’m aiming for tomorrow noon. I blocked time in the morning to get the 78 seats, October 1 start, net 45, and the invoice note lined up in the CRM, the pricing sheet, the quote packet, and the billing request before deal desk takes a look.

segments.speaker: Jordan
segments.text: Cool. If deal desk asks, tell them the go-live is October 14, right?

segments.speaker: Maya
segments.text: Yep, October 14 for the first location, then the other four by November 7. They don’t need data migration, just user import and permission groups.

segments.speaker: Jordan
segments.text: Sounds clean. Send me the draft before you route it, and I’ll sanity-check the totals.

segments.speaker: Maya
segments.text: Will do. Total contract value should land at $46,112 before tax, assuming the seat count doesn’t move.
